what_it_provides: Books, articles, maps, audio recordings, manuscripts; primary preservation repository for Kumaoni heritage
Audio, video and image documentation of Kumaoni Baithaki, Khadi and Mahila Holi traditions
Digitized Kumaoni books, poetry collections, classical literature and linguistic materials
Out-of-copyright digitized books on Kumaon folklore, history, music, and Himalayan customs
Bibliographic discovery and catalogued volumes indexed under Kumaoni folk songs and oral traditions
1996, 197-page selected Kumaoni folk-song anthology with Hindi translations and cultural annotations
Regional-language preservation publications including Ghughuti Basuti and Nyauli Sankalan
